text:
Morgan: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — leadership asked for the "small-batch" playbook we can start this sprint to demonstrate our serving advantage. Keep it tactical and measurable.
Asha: Proposal: ship 3 customer-facing wins in 6 weeks: 1) migration adapter CLI + checklist, 2) per-route cost demo in Console, 3) a reproducible perf script for a chat workload.
Riley: Marketing wants 1-line proofs for each. Options: 'Migrate with minimal code changes', 'See per-route unit economics before you commit', 'Validate p95 gains with our script'. Thoughts?
Priya: Field note: buyers respond to specific numbers. Add an expected delta: e.g., "~20% lower token spend in chat pilots" from caching.
Diego: Engineering caveat: adapter must be non-infringing. We'll ship a mapping layer and example code, not a binary copy. ETA: 2 dev-weeks for an MVP.
Sam: Metrics to instrument now? I suggest: # adapter downloads, Dedicated eval -> convert (30d), avg estimated tokens saved per customer, and homepage CTA conversion for the two new headlines.
Noor: Optimize note: suggestions should be opt-in and gated by an A/B quality check. We'll add a "preview impact" button to Console.
Asha: I'll draft the 6-week plan and owners. Riley — can you get the 1-line proofs polished for Sales? Priya — can you provide anonymized win/loss snippets?
Riley: On it. I'll have Sales-ready bullets by EOD tomorrow.
Priya: Sharing snippets now, will anonymize.
InfraBot: Follow-up doc & draft plan uploaded: https://confluence.redwood/ah/1795554321
Morgan: Great. Action items: Asha (6-week plan), Diego (adapter MVP), Sam (dashboards), Riley (sales proofs), Priya (win/loss feed). We'll review progress in one week. :calendar:
